health.title: System health
health.intro: The state of each service this store uses. Only names and states are shown, never configuration values.

reasons.database_connected: Connected to a replica set. Transactions are available.
reasons.database_not_configured: MONGODB_URI is not set. The store shows the setup page until it is.
reasons.database_not_replica_set: Reachable, but not a replica set. Orders need transactions, so database writes are refused.
reasons.database_unreachable: Configured, but the server cannot reach it. Check the connection string and the database's network access list.
reasons.cache_not_configured: Not set. Sign-in, checkout and forms refuse requests in production until it is.
reasons.cache_memory_fallback: Not set. This development server limits requests per process instead, which is not shared between instances.
reasons.cache_unreachable: Configured, but the server cannot reach it. Limited requests are refused.
reasons.configured_not_checked: Configured. A live check is added when the feature that uses it is built.
reasons.optional_not_configured: Optional and not set. The features that use it stay hidden.
reasons.incomplete: Partly set. Every listed variable is needed.
reasons.jobs_trigger_not_set: JOBS_TRIGGER is not set, so nothing drains the outbox.
reasons.jobs_database_unavailable: The trigger is set. Outbox numbers need the database.
reasons.jobs_never_drained: Rows are waiting and the outbox has never been drained.
reasons.jobs_drain_stale: Rows are waiting and the last successful drain is older than {minutes} minutes.
reasons.jobs_dead_letters: Some rows failed every attempt and need attention.
reasons.jobs_no_drain_yet: No drain has run yet. Nothing is waiting.

triggerValues.http: HTTP drain called by a scheduler

health.outboxUnavailable: Outbox numbers need a connected database.

setup.title: Set up the store owner

blocker.email: Email is not configured (RESEND_API_KEY, EMAIL_FROM). The owner must verify their email (decision D23).

setup.done: This store already has an owner.

staff.title: Staff
staff.intro: People with access to this admin and the role each one has.
staff.addIntro: The person needs a HorekBazar account with a verified email. Changing a role signs them out everywhere.
staff.stepUpBody: Changing staff needs a fresh code from your authenticator app (valid 10 minutes).
staff.stepUpActive: Confirmed. Staff changes are allowed until {time}.

security.title: Your security
security.intro: Two-step verification and sign-in for your staff account.
security.secondFactorBody: Your account uses two-step verification, and this sign-in has not checked it yet. Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to open the admin.

stepUp.title: Confirm it is you
stepUp.body: Stock changes need a fresh code from your authenticator app. One code lasts 10 minutes.
stepUp.needsTwoFactor: Stock changes need two-step verification. Turn it on in Security first.

catalogue.sampleTitle: Generated sample data for testing (not a real product). It can be published only in the development database.
catalogue.sampleNoticeDev: This is generated sample data. In this development database it can be published for testing; it can never be published in production.
catalogue.sampleNoticeBlocked: This is generated sample data. It cannot be published in this database.
catalogue.deleteConfirm: I understand this cannot be undone

fields.slugHint: Lower-case Latin letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. miniket-rice-5kg. Fixed after the first publish.
fields.name: Name
fields.primaryCategoryHint: Only the lowest level of the tree can hold products.
fields.alsoInHint: Optional. Hold Ctrl (or ⌘) to choose more than one.
fields.attributesHint: One per line: key | label | value | English label | English value. English is optional. Example: origin | উৎপত্তি | বাংলাদেশ | Origin | Bangladesh
fields.skuHint: Capital letters, digits and hyphens, unique across the store.
fields.variantTitleHint: Shown on the size chip and cart line, e.g. ৫ কেজি.
fields.priceHint: Taka, up to 2 decimals, e.g. 425 or 425.50.
fields.compareAtHint: Optional. Must be higher than the price.
fields.netVerified: Net quantity checked on the pack
fields.netVerifiedHint: Only a checked quantity is shown on the label tile.
fields.weightHint: Packed weight in grams, for delivery.
fields.optionsHint: Optional. One per line: key | value | English value, e.g. size | ৫ কেজি | 5 kg.
fields.rightsHint: Where the right to use this image comes from, e.g. "Photographed by store staff, 2026".

upload.fileHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB.
upload.uploaded: Uploaded. Add the details below and save.
upload.failed: The upload did not work. Please try again.
upload.notConfigured: Image upload is not set up yet (Cloudinary). Products show their label tile until it is.
upload.tooLarge: That file is larger than 10 MB.

products.title: Products
products.emptyHint: Create the first product, or load the sample catalogue into the development database.
products.emptyFilteredHint: Try a different search or clear the filters.
products.name: Name
products.newIntro: A new product starts as a draft. Add variants with prices next, then publish.
products.created: Draft created. Add a variant with a price, then publish.
products.previewPhoto: The first image is shown on the storefront.
products.previewLabelTile: No photo yet, so the storefront shows this label tile.
products.previewLabelTileNoQuantity: No photo and no checked net quantity, so the tile shows only the category.
products.publishRule: Publishing needs a published main category and at least one active variant with a price.
products.slugFrozen: This product has been published, so its web address can no longer change.
products.variantsIntro: Each variant has its own SKU, price and stock.
products.noVariants: No variants yet. Add one below.

products.deleteConfirm: I understand this cannot be undone
products.bulkLabel: Change the status of selected products
products.bulkHint: Up to 25 at a time. Each product is checked on its own: publishing needs a published category and a priced active variant.

categories.title: Categories
categories.intro: Up to three levels. Only the lowest level holds products. Publish a parent before its children.
categories.slugFrozen: Published once, so the web address is fixed.
categories.moveHint: The tree cannot go deeper than three levels, and a category cannot move under itself.
categories.deleteConfirm: I understand this cannot be undone
categories.parentHint: Leave as top level, or choose where it belongs.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.intro: Receive new stock or correct counts. Every change is recorded with who made it and why.
inventory.drift: {count} stock records differ from the history. Nothing was changed automatically; please check them.
inventory.prompt: Search for a product or SKU, or show low stock.
inventory.qtyHint: Receive: a positive number. Adjust: positive to add, negative (e.g. -2) to remove.
inventory.reasonHint: Required for adjustments, e.g. "damaged in storage".

collections.title: Collections
collections.intro: Hand-picked sets of products from any category.
collections.productsHint: Hold Ctrl (or ⌘) to choose several. Order follows the list.

banners.title: Banners
banners.intro: Images with a link, shown in a chosen place. Every image needs a description and recorded rights.
banners.hrefHint: A path inside the store, e.g. /c/rice. Leave empty for no link.
banners.notConfigured: Banner upload is not set up yet (Cloudinary credentials are missing).

homepage.intro: The storefront homepage is built from these sections, in order. A section can be published only when everything it shows is published.

typeHints.banner: One banner from the banners list.

homepage.subtitle: Subheading
